headline: Site plan to convert the 103 North State Street office building into 21 residential units, plus sign applications and building permits.
summary: Six sign applications are listed, including new wall signs at 80 Commercial St and 285 Loudon Rd. Two building permit requests cover a restaurant loggia on Pleasant Street and a storefront replacement and fence at 38 South Main Street.
items: Sign for 80 Commercial St: new 37.2-square-foot internally illuminated building wall sign
Sign for 16 Wall Street: new 8.81-square-foot externally illuminated freestanding sign replacing an existing sign
Sign for 8 Loudon Rd: new 35-square-foot internally illuminated building wall sign
Signs for 1 Capitol St: two new non-illuminated building wall signs replacing two existing signs
Sign for 388 Loudon Rd: new 42-square-foot internally illuminated freestanding sign panel replacing an existing panel
Signs for 285 Loudon Rd: two new 33.28-square-foot wall signs and a 30.5-square-foot freestanding sign panel
Building permit for 60, 62 Pleasant Street and 2-10 N Spring St: 650-square-foot façade alteration for a loggia at a restaurant, and relocation of a 12-square-foot pylon sign
Building permit for 38 South Main Street: replacement of storefront, sidelights, and transom, and a fence along the north side
Site plan for 103 North State Street: conversion of a 15,341-square-foot office building into 21 residential dwelling units
location: City Council Chambers, 37 Green St, Concord, NH 03301
plain_text:
ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE 
May 5, 2026, 8:30 a.m. 
City Council Chambers, 37 Green St, Concord, NH 03301 
 
AGENDA 
 
1. Call to Order 
2. Minutes – Approve meeting minutes from March 31, 2026 
3. Staff Memorandum 
4. Sign Applications 
4.1 Advantage Signs, on behalf of New Hampshire Retirement System, requests an architectural design review 
recommendation for a new 37.2-square-foot internally illuminated building wall sign (SP-0746-2026) at 80 
Commercial St in the Opportunity Corridor Performance (OCP) District. (2026 -030) (PL-ADR-2026-0171). 
(2026-031) (PL-CUP-2026-0109) 
4.2 Wall Street Dental Group, PLLC, on behalf of 16 Wall St LLC, and Wall Street Dental Group, requests an 
architectural design review recommendation for a new 8.81-square-foot externally illuminated freestanding 
sign (SP-0755-2026) to replace an existing freestanding sign, at 16 Wall Street in the Civic Performance (CVP) 
District. (2026-032) (PL-ADR-2026-0172) 
4.3 Green Bear Signs and Graphic, LLC, on behalf of Flomac Limited Partnership, and Back Nine, requests an 
architectural design review recommendation for a new 35-square-foot internally illuminated building wall sign 
(SP-0759-2026) at 8 Loudon Rd in the Gateway Performance (GWP) District. (2026-036) (PL-ADR-2026-
0174) 
4.4 Merrimack County Savings Bank/NH Mutual Bancorp, on behalf of Capitol Street Associates and Ransmeier 
& Spellman, and NH Trust, requests architectural design review approvals for two new non-illuminated 
building walls signs of 18.5-square-feet (SP-0760-2026) and 23.75-square-feet (SP-0761-2026), to replace two 
existing building wall signs at 1 Capitol St in the Central Business Performance (CBP) District. (2026-037) 
(PL-ADR-2026-0175) 
4.5 Spectrum Signs and Graphics, on behalf of B & L Transmissions, LLC, and 603 Bar -B-Q, requests an 
architectural design review recommendation for a new 42-square-foot internally illuminated free standing sign 
panel (SP-0762-2026), to replace an existing freestanding sign panel, at 388 Loudon Rd in the Gateway 
Performance (GWP) District. (2026-039) (PL-ADR-2026-0177) 
4.6 Classic Signs Inc. LLC, on behalf of GMX-RP-SCU-Concord LLC, Dundee Investments LLC, and Service 
Credit Union requests architectural design review recommendations for two new 33.28- square-foot internally 
illuminated building wall signs (SP-0751-2026 and SP-0752-2026) and a new 30.5-square-foot internally 
illuminated freestanding sign panel (SP-0753-2026) to be placed on an existing freestanding sign, at 285 
Loudon Rd in the Gateway Performance (GWP) District. (2026-043) (PL-ADR-2026-0178) 
5. Building Permit Applications 
5.1 Wilson & Wilson Architects, on behalf of Spring Corner Condominium, and Nonna’s Place, LLC, requests an

6. Site Plan Applications 
6.1 Stonefield Engineering and Design, on behalf of Associated Enterprises Inc, requests architectural design 
review recommendation as part of a major site plan application for the conversion of an existing 15,341-
square-foot office building into 21 residential dwelling units and associated site improvements at Tax Map 
6414Z Lot 1, addressed as 103 North State Street in the Civic Performance (CVP) District. (2026-028) (PL-
SPR-2026-0059) (PL-CUP-2026-0108)
